rai:intendedUse: Artifact review, benchmark inspection, saved-output replay, and paper-method audit for reliable co-success under bounded state transfer. This artifact is not a general-purpose LLM leaderboard.
rai:limitations: The clean-v2 five-model 7,200-row row-level execution closure and submission aggregate result tables are included; final public hosting metadata and venue-facing manuscript claims remain separate release/manuscript layers.
Admission smoke rows are excluded from primary aggregation.
Budget 300 is diagnostic only and must not be pooled into confirmatory method ranking.
Closed-model live API reruns are not expected to be byte-identical to saved outputs.
The task substrate is synthetic and calibration-conditioned, not a fully untouched public held-out benchmark.
The scoped SSR downgrade packet supports a method-disposition claim, not a universal SSR failure claim.
rai:dataLimitations: The artifact currently contains frozen protocol, planned row manifests, admission evidence, clean-v2 row-level execution closure records, submission aggregate result tables, and scoped SSR-downgrade evidence; final public hosting metadata and manuscript-level statistical interpretation remain outside the Croissant draft.
The task substrate is synthetic and calibration-conditioned, not a completely untouched held-out public benchmark.
Closed-model saved-output replay verifies recorded outputs and scores; it does not guarantee future live API reproducibility.
Budget 300 is a diagnostic stress regime and is excluded from confirmatory aggregation.
rai:dataBiases: The model axis is a frozen experimental sample of five model conditions, not a population-representative sample of all LLMs.
The task family emphasizes bounded state transfer and exact/governed co-success, so results may not generalize to open-ended reasoning, preference, or safety benchmarks.
Provider routes differ by condition: GPT and Claude are OpenRouter-routed, while DeepSeek, Kimi, and Qwen are direct-provider conditions.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No known personal or sensitive information is included. The benchmark uses synthetic task content and model-generated responses, not human-subject records, demographic labels, medical records, financial records, private documents, or scraped social-media data.
rai:dataUseCases: Benchmark inspection for reliable co-success under bounded state transfer.
Method and metric analysis after respecting diagnostic-vs-confirmatory boundaries.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Positive impact: improves auditability of closed-model evaluation by separating saved-output replay from live API reruns and by documenting benchmark limits.
Risk: users may overinterpret the benchmark as a general LLM leaderboard, safety benchmark, or live-provider reproducibility guarantee.
Mitigation: the benchmark card, RAI note, and claim map restrict claims to scoped reliable co-success under the frozen protocol.
rai:dataSensitivity: Synthetic task and model-output artifact. It does not contain human-subject records, private documents, demographic labels, medical records, financial records, or scraped social-media data.
rai:knownRisks: Evaluation claim overreach beyond the bounded state-transfer setting.
Provider routing or closed-model drift if users rerun live APIs instead of replaying saved outputs.
Mistaking diagnostic or admission rows for primary results.
Overfitting to a calibration-conditioned synthetic task substrate.
rai:recommendedUses: Verify saved outputs, hash locks, scorer behavior, and replay cassettes.
Inspect benchmark design and variable controls.
Evaluate scoped reliable co-success claims only after respecting the execution-versus-aggregation boundary.
rai:outOfScopeUses: Claims about model safety or human preference.
Claims that current live APIs reproduce historical saved outputs.
rai:maintenancePlan: Update this metadata after public hosting, license choice, DOI assignment, final archive checksums, and full main-matrix result manifests are fixed.
